snippet.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Songs of the Past | gamescom 2026 Showcase Supercut
snippet.description:
Feels good to be back on the Path with Songs of the Past!

During gamescom 2026, the team presented gameplay from the upcoming third expansion to The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. We’ve put this showcase together to give you a taste of what’s to come from Geralt’s next adventure as he travels to the brand-new realm of Letten. Enjoy!

Songs of the Past launches in 2027 on PC, PlayStation 5, GOG, Steam, Epic Games Store, Battle.net, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2. Wishlist now!

https://www.thewitcher.com/buy
